NH Division of Motor Vehicles Fee Increases effective January 1st, 2026 
NH DMV is implementing an increase to the state fees for vehicle registrations/titles effective January 1st, 2026. 
If you have a vehicle registration that has not yet been renewed this year, you will want to renew it  before  December 31st, 2025, to avoid any price increases. 
This means ALL vehicle registration renewals not processed in our office BY December 31st, 2025, will be subject to this fee increase. 
Residents with January vehicle registration renewal notices have been sent, and it  Does Not  include the price increase. If you send in payment after December 31st, 2025, your payment will need to be adjusted to reflect the new price increase. All payments received in the mail after that date will be returned if they are not the right amount. 
The Online Renewal for Motor Vehicles Will Be Unavailable From December 30, 2025, to January 5, 2026, for the Installation of the Update to These New Fees. 
The 2025 tax rate has been set at $17.80. The 2025 second issue tax bills will be mailed on November 6, 2025, and will be due on Tuesday, December 9, 2025. Bills can be viewed and paid online by clicking on Pay Property Taxes. If you do not receive a bill or if you have questions regarding your bill, please contact the Tax Collector's Office at 603-887-4870.

Request for Duplicate Registrations 
If you need a duplicate registration , you must come to the Town Clerk's office to request one. The fee is $23. 
If your renewal was done online and you didn't receive it in the mail,  you need to go to the DMV to receive your renewal and decals. There is no charge for this. 
If you have  lost your registration and decals , you must come to the Town Clerk's office for replacements. The fee is $31. 
Please be clear in explaining what your situation is so we can assist you appropriately. 
Request for Duplicate Property Tax Bill 
The tax collector is requesting that all residents who request a duplicate property tax bill be sent to a different location, fill out the following form, and send it in right away. This form will need to be updated yearly. We have many residents who go away for the winter months and need their tax bills sent to a different location.
